title: Normalized native module comparison commutes with restriction
statement: Let ell be prime, let theta_X identify the condensed finite-subextension coefficient ring R_X with the underlying abelian native coefficient algebra B_X by [lem-sf-locally-finite-coefficient-ring-realization], and let E_X be native scalar forgetting followed by restriction of scalars along theta_X. For every scheme morphism h:S to T there is a natural isomorphism h_native^* followed by E_S is isomorphic to E_T followed by h_condensed^*. The ordinary target here is the existing category of internal abelian modules over R_X; no immersion or finite-type assumption on h is imposed.

source.place: Tags 03CW, 03CY and 03EK; agent internal-action and adjunction comparison, native module comparison step 4

proof.text: Direct image of native scalar sheaves commutes strictly with forgetting scalars, by its existing monoidal comparison. Apply mapModCompIso and mapModComapIso and collapse successive scalar restrictions with comapComp. The resulting coefficient maps are equal by the direct-image naturality clause of theta. Thus native direct image followed by E_T is naturally isomorphic to E_S followed by condensed direct image.

Each E_X is an equivalence by ambient scalar forgetting and scalar change along the ring isomorphism theta_X. Use the adjunctions E_X inverse left adjoint to E_X, together with the two inverse-image/direct-image adjunctions. Conjugating the direct-image isomorphism gives condensed inverse image followed by E_S inverse isomorphic to E_T inverse followed by native inverse image. Whisker with E_T and E_S and cancel the equivalence unit and counit to obtain the claimed comparison.

theorem nativeScalarForgetting_pullbackIso (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (h : S ⟶ T) :
    let θ := (locallyFiniteCoefficientRing_realization ℓ).choose
    letI (X : Scheme.{u}) : IsMonHom (θ X).hom :=
      (locallyFiniteCoefficientRing_realization ℓ).choose_spec.1 X
    Nonempty (adicUpperStar ℓ h ⋙ AdicSheaf.forgetAb ℓ S ⋙ Mod.comap (θ S).hom ≅
      AdicSheaf.forgetAb ℓ T ⋙ Mod.comap (θ T).hom ⋙
        CondensedRing.upperStar (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) h)
